title: Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual agents that read dense documents must ration a finite observation budget across candidate regions, yet answer accuracy conflates where an agent looks, how it adapts to the reads that remain, and how it an?swers once observation stops. We introduce budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining budget or de?clared task parameters, and credits every acquired history with exact continuation values. translated_title: 选择观察什么：用于视觉智能体可信评估的预算配对反事实审计
translated_abstract: 阅读密集文档的视觉智能体必须在候选区域之间合理分配有限的观察预算，然而答案准确率将智能体的观察位置选择、对剩余读取内容的适应方式以及停止观察后的回答方式混为一谈。我们提出了预算配对反事实审计这一评估协议，它在保持公共证据和区域绑定不变的同时，仅对剩余预算或声明的任务参数进行扰动，并为每个已获取的历史记录赋予精确的延续价值。由此产生的核算体系将损失的预期准确率分解为逐步获取损失和终端决策损失，从而将智能体的规划能力与固定角色启发式方法区分开来。在四十个配对路由锚点和五个开放权重（模型上进行的实验表明……）（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出预算配对反事实审计这一评估协议，通过固定公共证据与区域绑定、仅扰动剩余观察预算或任务参数，将视觉智能体的准确率损失分解为逐步获取损失与终端决策损失，从而可信地将智能体的规划能力与决策能力分离评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining observation budget or task parameters, decomposing lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss to credibly separate and evaluate visual agents' planning and decision-making abilities.
